chain.text: The estate farms 18 hectares. 11 hectares are Cabernet Franc and 7 are Chenin Blanc. Soils are clay and flint. Production averages 62,000 bottles a year. The 2024 harvest yielded 48,000 bottles. May hail destroyed about a fifth of the crop on western plots. Certification is organic since 2019. Biodynamic conversion began in 2023. It requires three compliant years. Earliest biodynamic certification is 2026. Export is 41 percent of sales. Main export markets are Belgium and Japan. The Japanese importer requires sulphites below 60 mg per litre. In 2022 tank 4's controller drifted 3 degrees for two days. That batch lost its aromatic profile. It sold in bulk at an 11,000-euro loss. Controllers are now calibrated before each harvest. Tank 4 has a second probe. In 2023 a label error sent 900 wrong-vintage bottles to a distributor. All were recalled. Label proofs now need two signatures. No irrigation is allowed
